production_execution.omitted_step: BlendEMU step 4 combined catalogues are redundant because acceptance reads the retained per-case truth, shape, and cross-match catalogues directly.
production_execution.launch_sequence: Submit block 0 alone as a full-density capacity check. Submit blocks 1--37 only after block 0 has a validated_and_pruned receipt; do not inspect a response statistic between stages.
production_execution.array_safety: The job script has no default array directive and accepts only explicit indices 0..37. Block 0 is submitted alone before any 1--37 array.
production_execution.restart_rule: Restart block 0 from an empty production path with the exact trial9 artifact, immutable renderer/config snapshot, explicit pre-training SExtractor 2.29.0 RoyBranch binary, pinned Python environment versions, and the corrected 38-block validator.

population.order: truth support, per-leg detection/usable status, then per-leg measured magnitude and radius cuts

response_evaluation.block_aggregation_contract: Reconstruct the pooled estimator and one case-cluster bootstrap from every per-case, per-model, per-QMC sufficient statistic; reject missing, duplicate, or identity-inconsistent blocks.
response_evaluation.decision_summary_contract: Verify the four endpoint/protocol identities, stored numerical/equivalence decisions, and central component-robustness gate, then emit one compact pass-to-full-inference or reject-candidate decision without accepting thresholds or recalculating response statistics.
response_evaluation.crowding_source: derive the three shear-invariant crowding inputs from the truth scene already loaded by the evaluator; no separate lookup is required

qmc_numerical_gate.acceptance_rule: Estimate the QMC standard error of m across the four frozen seeds. It must not exceed 0.005 percentage points; expand both case-bootstrap interval endpoints by the two-sided 95% Student-t half-width with 3 degrees of freedom before applying the equivalence band.

component_robustness_gate.acceptance_rule: The central truth-population and conditional measurement-residual contributions to m must each lie strictly inside [-0.3,+0.3] percentage points. This rejects a net pass obtained by cancelling an individually out-of-band component; it is not a separate component equivalence-interval claim.

response_evaluation.bootstrap_unit: simulation case with every leg kept in the same resample cluster
response_evaluation.gate: For every endpoint, the marginal case-bootstrap 95% interval for m_percent, expanded by the frozen QMC 95% half-width, must be strictly inside [-0.3, +0.3], QMC SE must be at most 0.005 percentage points, and both central truth-population and measurement-residual m contributions must be strictly inside [-0.3,+0.3]. All four must pass.
secondary_checks: report R21 and R12 cross-response without tuning
report truth-shape and measurement-residual response components to expose cancellation
report every unmatched, unusable, nonfinite, and out-of-support row

response_execution.task_mapping: task = 4 * simulation_block + endpoint, for 38 blocks and endpoint order [g1_h002, g1_h004, g2_h002, g2_h004]
response_execution.explicit_array: 0-151 with maximum concurrency 4; there is no default array directive
response_execution.launch_condition: Every one of the 38 simulation block receipts must say validated_and_pruned before any response task starts.
response_execution.selected_block_integrity: Each task rehashes its R_blend lookup and both retained shear-leg truth/noise/shape/cross-match catalogues against the simulation receipt.
response_execution.per_block_bootstrap_note: Only schema-valid sufficient statistics are retained per block; the sole inferential 10000-replicate case bootstrap is run after all 38 blocks are pooled.

full_inference.run_condition: Run only after all four response endpoints pass; a response failure ends the candidate without retuning.
full_inference.gate: Using the same frozen candidate and case-clustered legs, the marginal 95% interval for inferred multiplicative bias must be strictly inside [-0.3, +0.3]% for both axes and both amplitudes.
full_inference.g0_check: Report both inferred additive components and their 95% intervals with no empirical subtraction.
full_inference.note: The 760-case assurance calculation is anchored to response-closure variance; it does not guarantee the full-inference interval width.
full_inference.readiness_limitation: No frozen 38-block, case-clustered, multi-axis full-inference worker/reducer exists yet. The generic image adapter resolves one flat simulation root and the generic inference summary is not a case-clustered finite-difference acceptance reducer. Design and resource-size this stage only if all four response gates pass.

assurance.planning_model: m_hat ~ Normal(m_true, 0.126 * sqrt(100/N) percentage points), with the case interval additively expanded by t_0.975,3 * 0.00629111449503968 * sqrt(50/N) percentage points for four-seed QMC error
assurance.method: union bound using four marginal failure probabilities
assurance.limitation: Conditional design assurance, not a candidate performance claim. The conservative QMC term is the worse actual SEM of the already frozen four seeds, not an estimate inferred from all 16 historical seeds; variance transfer, QMC 1/sqrt(N) scaling, and normal approximations may still fail. The fresh QMC numerical gate is mandatory.
